title: New Application Ideas of Dynamics 365 Business Central (2025 MAY)
summary: The post presents a comprehensive list of feature improvement ideas submitted to Dynamics 365 Business Central for May 2025, organized by functional areas including finance, sales, inventory, manufacturing, and more. It serves as a resource for developers, consultants, and users seeking proposed enhancements across all Business Central modules.
key_points: The post lists community improvement ideas for Business Central from May 2025, grouped by area such as data migration, development, finance, inventory, manufacturing, sales, purchasing, service and tenant administration.

Development ideas include CSVBuffer export with varying column counts, GetType/GetSubType for Variants, preprocessors in app.json, an event in the Transfer Extended Text codeunit and parallel AppSource version delivery.
Finance ideas cover Intrastat statistical value and country of origin, bank reconciliation changes, additional-currency amounts in posting previews and source currency VAT amounts in VAT entries.
General ideas include Copilot assessing business rules in description fields, vision-enabled OpenAI model support, tri-state lock timeout tracking and Mandatory Fields for non-developers.
Localization and sales ideas include EU VAT validation, E-Documents line types, OSS reporting for Austria and several Shopify Connector requests.
features: Edit in Excel for Sales and Purchase Prices
E-Documents support for other line types
Intrastat statistical value with item charges

quotes.text: Would any of these ideas improve Business Central? Here is a list of some of them.
quotes.why_it_matters: Sets the purpose of the post as a curated collection of community-sourced feature suggestions for Business Central improvement.
